# Reporting (SSRS and business documents)

## 1. Is it an SSRS change at all?

- **Analytics** ("see X by Y", trends, dashboards) → Power BI / Fabric / Synapse Link, not
  SSRS. Out of scope for these agents; say so in the assessment.
- **Business documents** (invoice, PO, confirmation, packing slip): check first whether
  **Business document management** (Electronic Reporting with Word/Excel templates) meets
  the need — business users can change layout and add data without code or deployment
  ([BDM overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/analytics/er-business-document-management)).
  Prefer it when the document already has an ER format and the team can maintain ER.
- Otherwise it is an SSRS change — continue.

## 2. Read large reports safely

Business documents can be tens of thousands of lines of RDL. Never load it all.

- `get_object_info(objectType="report", name=…)` returns the summary: designs, datasets,
  fields, RDL element counts. That is enough to plan.
- Use `includeRdl: true` only for one named design you must inspect, and only when the
  summary cannot answer the question.
- Identify the data provider (DP), contract, controller and temp table from the summary and
  `get_object_info` on those classes.

## 3. Pick the technique

Ask the server for the exact patterns: `get_knowledge(topic="report-extension-patterns")`,
plus `ssrs-reports`, `ssrs-rdp-preprocess`, `print-management` as needed.

| Need | Technique |
|---|---|
| New fields on an existing report | Extend the DP's temp table (table extension) and fill the fields in a `PostHandlerFor` on the DP's `processReport` (one pass over the finished temp table). Then refresh the dataset. |
| A different layout for a Print-management document | Custom design: duplicate the report, subclass the controller, subscribe to `PrintMgmtDocType.getDefaultReportFormatDelegate`, extend the menu item to point to the new controller. |
| Same report, different entry point or controller | Extend the output menu item and change its object/controller reference. |
| A new report | `object_patterns(domain="report")` recipe, then `generate_object(mode="scaffold", objectType="report")`. |

RDP classes are not extended directly — use the handlers above.

## 4. Duplicate, never rename

- Duplicate the **whole standard report** into the custom model under a prefixed name. Delete
  the designs you don't need **from the copy** — that is how the copy gets small.
- The standard report and its designs are never changed or renamed. They stay as the fallback.
- Don't keep renamed old versions of your own designs (`Report_old`). Source control is the
  history.
- The copy keeps using the standard data contract, so platform changes to the contract and DP
  still reach it.

## 5. Choosing the design

- List the designs found in the report (including country-specific ones) and recommend one
  based on the legal entity's country and the business need.
- Ask the user which **report format Print management uses today** for this document — the
  server cannot see Print management setup. Record the answer.
- The user confirms the design before the TDD is signed off.

## 6. Who does what

The server's report write path only refreshes datasets and adds parameters; it **never
changes layout**, because a broken RDL fails only at render time. Follow that split.

| Agents (MCP, validated) | Developer by hand in Visual Studio |
|---|---|
| Temp table extension, DP post-handler, controller subclass, Print management delegate handler, menu item extension | *Duplicate in project* of the standard report |
| `d365fo_file(action="modify", objectType="report", operation="report-design")` with `reportAction` `refresh-dataset` or `add-parameter` (contract: `get_knowledge(kind="op-spec", topic="report-design")`) | Layout changes in Report Designer |
| Labels for every caption and expression | Deploy reports after build |

For the manual part, the TDD gives an exact checklist: design name, tablix/textbox, position,
field binding (`=Fields!<Field>.Value`), caption label (`=Labels!@<Model>:<LabelId>`), format.

## 7. Reversibility and deployment

- Switching to the new design and back is a **Print management** setup change
  (e.g. *Accounts receivable > Setup > Forms > Form setup > Print management*), not a
  deployment — record the exact setup path for the document in the TDD.
- Reports must be deployed after build, or the old layout shows with no error.
- ([Create custom designs for business documents](https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/analytics/custom-designs-business-docs))
